scripts.deploy:local: mvn -B -q package -DskipTests && pnpm run deploy:platform && pnpm run deploy:provider && pnpm run deploy:quote
scripts.deploy:platform: cd platform/events && AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=test AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=test AWS_REGION=us-east-1 sls deploy --stage local
scripts.deploy:provider: cd provider-solution && AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=test AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=test AWS_REGION=us-east-1 sls deploy --stage local
scripts.deploy:quote: cd quote-solution && AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=test AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=test AWS_REGION=us-east-1 sls deploy --stage local
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run deploy:local && mvn -B verify -Pe2e -pl quote-solution/e2e
